visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a grand concert hall setting with amber stage lighting and a dark background. A middle-aged man in a formal black tuxedo and white bow tie is seated at a large black grand piano, his head bowed in deep concentration. Orchestral musicians with violins are visible in the background, out of focus. Large yellow captions appear at the top. (2) The scene shifts to a bright indoor studio with a light grid-patterned background. The same man is seen in a casual grey checkered blazer over a white t-shirt featuring a colorful floral print. He stands next to a woman in a white short-sleeved dress. Both are gesturing and smiling towards the camera. Animated pink bubbles and graphic icons float around them. (3) A series of quick cuts follow, showing a close-up of a glass of sparkling wine on a dark table, a brown wooden piano, and the man waving cheerfully in front of a solid pink background. Yellow character labels flash on screen. (4) The camera returns to a medium shot of the man performing on stage. His facial expression is intense, showing slight sweat, as his hands move rapidly across the piano keys. Yellow text highlights appear on the left. (5) A graphic screen displays a long list of traditional Chinese text on a parchment-style overlay. The man and woman are shown in a small inset at the bottom, looking friendly and engaged. (6) A wide shot captures a full orchestra on stage with the pianist at the center. Red stage curtains are visible in the background. The man is then shown standing on a red carpeted stage holding a large bouquet of white flowers. (7) The final phase shows the man and woman against a white background, laughing and pointing toward the viewer. Large promotional text with dates and location details fills the screen.
